title: Fibroadenoma
notice: Synthetic and AI-written. Needs review by a pathologist before being used to score anything (issue #22).

keys.span: a benign, non-cancerous lump made of glandular and connective tissue, and it's common in younger women
keys.correct: A fibroadenoma is a benign lump made of glandular and connective tissue, most common in younger women.
keys.source_hint: WHO classification of breast tumours; CAP breast biopsy reporting
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: Most fibroadenomas can simply be watched over time.
keys.issue: Doesn't say what watching involves or when to come back.
keys.correct: Follow-up usually means a clinical exam and/or ultrasound in a few months to check the size, and coming back sooner if it grows or changes.
keys.source_hint: NCCN breast cancer screening and diagnosis
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: Fibroadenomas usually turn into cancer, so we have to remove it
keys.issue: Overstates the risk: simple fibroadenomas very rarely become cancer.
keys.correct: Simple fibroadenomas very rarely become cancer. Most don't need removal and can be monitored; removal is considered if it grows, is large or causes symptoms.
keys.source_hint: NCCN breast cancer screening and diagnosis; WHO classification of breast tumours
keys.speaker: doctor
